assets.name: activity-wheel
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production-ready mobile UI shortcut icon, square composition, real transparent background.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing navigation icons from the actual website. Create a new companion icon that looks like the SAME artist drew it. Match their chunky near-black plum outlines, simple rounded shapes, creamy ivory and pale lavender gradient fills, modest dusty-rose accents, crisp tiny white highlights, and a slightly extruded dark shadow below. Front-facing or very slight three-quarter view. This is a clean 2.5D cartoon game-menu icon, NOT a photorealistic render, not complex shiny gold illustration.
Composition: centered, one large compact readable silhouette occupying about 84% of the square, evenly padded. Must be immediately recognizable displayed at 78 px.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINT: NO text, letters, words, numbers, money amounts, currency symbols, logos, watermarks, banners, captions, labels, background tile, ground plane, scenery, or checkerboard. All labels are rendered separately in HTML. Background must have actual transparent alpha.
Subject: a lucky prize wheel. A bold upright circular wheel with eight simple wedges alternating cream, pale lavender and muted rose, a small round center hub, a small downward triangular pointer above, and a short rounded pedestal. Clean strong outline, no markings inside the blank wedges. Keep the wheel almost front-on and the pedestal unobtrusive.
assets.finalEditPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Target: supplied transparent wheel UI icon.
Make a narrowly targeted COLOR CHANGE ONLY. The hot-pink triangular pointer at the top, and the three saturated pink wheel wedges. Do not recolor the lavender and cream wedges, pale lavender rim, central hub or pedestal.
Replace the bright saturated candy-pink base color in those specified regions with the site's REGISTER BUTTON color: a muted dusty rose / mauve-rose gradient, light/base #b05a85 and lower/base #a7507b (sRGB). The overall colored surface should clearly match these medium-dark desaturated rose colors, not bubblegum pink. Keep existing small white specular highlights and a restrained lighter rose on lit edges; the dominant body/midtone must be the register-button rose. Preserve original light/shadow structure, using darker rose for shaded parts. Do not make the whole icon monochrome.
Keep exact silhouette, proportions, object position, outer outline, internal outlines, shapes, gradients in unedited areas, small highlights, illustration style and canvas framing. Do not redesign or add anything. This is a color replacement, not a new illustration.
Preserve the original square1280x1280 canvas with the same padding and object size. Background must stay truly TRANSPARENT with alpha, including all exterior space and cutouts. No black/white/colored background, no ground plane, no background tile or checkerboard. No text, currency, label, watermark or new objects.
